svg.title: IDR Volume Against Regulator Expectations
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-idr-volume-vs-expectation; chapter number: 6; title: IDR Volume Against Regulator Expectations; subtitle: Reported dispute counts stepping down to the original annual forecast; chart type: funnel; stages: label: Anesthesia operator run rate; value: 5000000; display: 5M run rate; conversion: Highest cited pace; detail: One anesthesia operator cites a 5M dispute run rate.; label: Disputes filed in 2025; value: 2600000; display: 2.6M; conversion: High end of the 2.2M-2.6M range; detail: Providers filed 2.6 million disputes in 2025 and trigger more than 99% of them.; label: Disputes filed in 2024; value: 1400000; display: 1.4M; conversion: Prior-year count; detail: Volume reached 1.4M disputes in 2024, with providers winning roughly 80-90% of decisions.; label: Regulator forecast, upper bound; value: 22000; display: 22,000; conversion: Original expectation ceiling; detail: Regulators expected 17,000-22,000 annual cases.; label: Regulator forecast, lower bound; value: 17000; display: 17,000; conversion: Original expectation floor; detail: Roughly 17,000 disputes per year was the baseline expectation.; caption: Actual IDR filings ran orders of magnitude above the annual case count regulators planned for.; assumptions note: Stages are a descending ladder of separately reported counts, not a single cohort flowing between stages; the 5M figure is one operator's run rate.; note: Attributed to Long Reads, Explained (cSaC2n-3r9o) for 2025 filings and to employer, payer-analytics, and provider-filer practitioners including Zelis Healthcare (lhoUoQSpOCg) and HaloMD.

circle.title: label: Anesthesia operator run rate; value: 5000000; display: 5M run rate; conversion: Highest cited pace; detail: One anesthesia operator cites a 5M dispute run rate.
label: Disputes filed in 2025; value: 2600000; display: 2.6M; conversion: High end of the 2.2M-2.6M range; detail: Providers filed 2.6 million disputes in 2025 and trigger more than 99% of them.
label: Disputes filed in 2024; value: 1400000; display: 1.4M; conversion: Prior-year count; detail: Volume reached 1.4M disputes in 2024, with providers winning roughly 80-90% of decisions.
label: Regulator forecast, upper bound; value: 22000; display: 22,000; conversion: Original expectation ceiling; detail: Regulators expected 17,000-22,000 annual cases.
label: Regulator forecast, lower bound; value: 17000; display: 17,000; conversion: Original expectation floor; detail: Roughly 17,000 disputes per year was the baseline expectation.

text.title: Assumptions: Stages are a descending ladder of separately reported counts, not a single cohort flowing between stages; the 5M figure is one operator's run rate.
